assessment.title: A1 Level Assessment
assessment.description: A comprehensive assessment of A1 grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening, and integrated English use.
assessment.instructions: Complete all sections. Listening passages may be played a maximum of two times. Review your answers before submitting.

questions.prompt: Complete: My parents ___ at home.
questions.explanation: Use 'are' with the plural subject 'my parents'.

questions.prompt: Emma is my friend. ___ brother is a doctor.
questions.explanation: Use 'her' for something that belongs to Emma.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct phrase.
questions.explanation: Use 'an' before the vowel sound in 'orange'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct plural.
questions.explanation: Nouns ending in -x usually add -es.

questions.prompt: The keys here in my hand are mine. ___ keys are new.
questions.explanation: Use 'these' for plural things that are near.

questions.prompt: Complete: There ___ two cafés near the station.
questions.explanation: Use 'there are' with plural nouns.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.option_d: She does works in a bank.
questions.explanation: The third-person singular form is 'works'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use 'Does + subject + base verb'.

questions.prompt: Choose the best sentence.
questions.explanation: Frequency adverbs normally come before a main verb.

questions.prompt: Complete: Nina can ___ the piano.
questions.explanation: Use the base verb after 'can'.

questions.prompt: Look! The children ___ in the garden.
questions.explanation: Use the present continuous for an action happening now.

questions.prompt: Our English class is ___ Tuesday ___ 6:00 p.m.
questions.explanation: Use 'on' with days and 'at' with exact times.

questions.prompt: Which expression is appropriate when you meet someone for the first time?
questions.explanation: 'Nice to meet you' is a standard first-meeting expression.

questions.prompt: Which word means the place where a person lives?
questions.explanation: An address tells where someone lives.

questions.prompt: Which activity normally happens before going to bed?
questions.explanation: Dinner normally happens before bedtime.

questions.prompt: Which adverb means '0% of the time'?
questions.explanation: 'Never' means not at any time.

questions.prompt: If a person is able to swim, which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: 'Can' expresses ability.

questions.prompt: If the pharmacy is directly beside the bank, it is ___ the bank.
questions.explanation: 'Next to' means directly beside.

questions.prompt: Which is the most polite request?
questions.option_c: Can I have some water, please?
questions.explanation: 'Can I have..., please?' is a polite request.

questions.prompt: Someone says 'Thank you very much.' What is a natural response?
questions.explanation: 'You're welcome' is a common response to thanks.

questions.prompt: Which sentence contains an error?
questions.explanation: With 'they', use the base verb: 'They live'.

questions.prompt: Choose the best sentence for something happening right now.
questions.option_b: I am reading an email now.
questions.explanation: The present continuous describes an action happening now.

questions.prompt: Which sentence contains an error?
questions.explanation: Use 'on Monday', not 'in Monday'.

questions.prompt: You do not understand a person in a shop. What is the best response?
questions.explanation: This is a polite request for repetition.

passages.title: A New Routine
passages.instructions: Read the text carefully and answer the four questions.
passages.content_text: My name is Chloe, and I recently started a new job at a small travel company. I live about twenty minutes from the office, so I usually take the bus to work. I start at 8:30 every morning. At lunchtime, I often eat with my coworkers in a café across from the office. I finish work at 4:30. On Tuesdays and Thursdays, I go to an English class after work. The class starts at six, so I have time to go home first. I like my new routine because the office is friendly and my English class is interesting.

questions.prompt: How does Chloe usually go to work?
questions.explanation: The text says she usually takes the bus.

questions.prompt: What time does Chloe finish work?
questions.explanation: She finishes work at 4:30.

questions.prompt: Where is the café?
questions.explanation: The café is across from the office.

questions.prompt: How often does Chloe go to English class?
questions.explanation: She goes on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

passages.title: Community Center Information
passages.instructions: Read the notice and answer the four questions.
passages.content_text: Riverside Community Center is on Park Road, next to the public library. The center opens at 7:00 a.m. from Monday to Friday and at 9:00 a.m. on weekends. There is a small gym on the first floor and two classrooms upstairs. English classes are on Monday and Wednesday evenings at 6:30. A beginner computer class is on Saturday morning at 10:00. There is no parking behind the center, but there is a bus stop in front of the building. Visitors can ask for information at the front desk.

questions.prompt: What is next to the community center?
questions.explanation: The center is next to the public library.

questions.prompt: How many classrooms are there?
questions.explanation: There are two classrooms upstairs.

questions.prompt: When is the beginner computer class?
questions.explanation: The computer class is Saturday at 10:00.

questions.prompt: Which statement is true?
questions.option_a: There is parking behind the center.
questions.option_b: There is a bus stop in front of the center.
questions.option_d: The center opens at 9:00 every weekday.
questions.explanation: The notice says there is a bus stop in front.

passages.title: Checking In at a Hotel
passages.instructions: Listen to the conversation. You may play the audio twice.
passages.audio_text: Good evening. Welcome to the Park Hotel. How can I help you? Hi. I have a reservation. My name is Daniel Ruiz. Yes, Mr. Ruiz. You have a room for two nights. Your room is number 306 on the third floor. Breakfast is from seven to ten in the restaurant on the first floor. Thank you. Is there Wi-Fi in the room? Yes, there is. The password is on the card beside your room key. Great. Thank you very much.

questions.prompt: What is the guest's name?
questions.explanation: The guest says his name is Daniel Ruiz.

questions.prompt: How many nights is the reservation for?
questions.explanation: The receptionist says the room is for two nights.

questions.prompt: Where is the restaurant?
questions.explanation: Breakfast is in the restaurant on the first floor.

questions.prompt: Where can Daniel find the Wi-Fi password?
questions.option_b: On a card beside the room key
questions.explanation: The password is on the card beside the key.

passages.title: Meeting a Friend
passages.instructions: Listen to the phone conversation. You may play the audio twice.
passages.audio_text: Hi, Maya. Are you free on Saturday afternoon? Yes, I am. What do you want to do? There's a new café near the museum. Would you like to meet there? Sure. What time? How about three thirty? That's good. Is the café easy to find? Yes. It's on Green Street, between the museum and a bookstore. Great. I'll take the number twelve bus. It stops across from the museum. Perfect. See you Saturday at three thirty.

questions.prompt: When are they meeting?
questions.explanation: They agree on Saturday at three thirty.

questions.prompt: Where is the café?
questions.option_b: Between the museum and a bookstore
questions.explanation: The café is between the museum and a bookstore.

questions.prompt: What are the speakers mainly doing?
questions.explanation: They are arranging where and when to meet.

questions.prompt: How will Maya travel?
questions.explanation: She says she will take the number twelve bus.
